purpose: Review-only directory of potential external sources for the organisation's non-crypto revenue lanes. This is not an account connection, endorsement, eligibility decision, or promise of work or income.
region_focus: Canada and Ontario; verify every opportunity and platform term at time of use.

policy.revenue_recognition: Discovery leads, advertised rates, grants, and accepted tasks are not revenue. Record income only when earned under verified terms and separately reconcile cash received.

lanes.label: AI development and automation services
lanes.next_step: Build a small demonstrable service portfolio and verify client demand, fees, contract terms and payment protection before any proposal.

lanes.label: Freelance software and technical services
lanes.next_step: Match only tasks supported by demonstrable skills; verify Connects, platform fees, identity checks, payout method and dispute terms.

lanes.label: AI training, evaluation and data annotation
lanes.next_step: Prioritize YPAI and CrowdGen for manual Canada screening alongside Outlier/Alignerr; verify live tasks, qualifications, phone/ID checks, approved work, payout method, minimums, fees and timing before any commitment.

lanes.label: Reusable software and digital products
lanes.next_step: Validate demand before building; check current transaction, processing, refund, payout and tax terms.

lanes.label: Grants, innovation support and sponsorships
lanes.next_step: Separate project grants from individual open-source sponsorships; verify legal applicant eligibility, qualifying contribution history, fees, payout and reporting before applying or accepting.

lanes.label: Authorized security testing and responsible disclosure
lanes.next_step: Only test assets explicitly in scope under a current written program policy; never probe third-party systems without authorization.

lanes.label: Paid research and technical research tasks
lanes.next_step: No standalone research-task platform is enabled yet. Research Canada eligibility, real task supply, fees, KYC and withdrawal evidence before adding one.

lanes.label: Public GitHub issue and bounty leads
lanes.next_step: Use GitHub/BOSS/Algora only as discovery candidates; verify sponsor, live funding, current claim state, acceptance terms, Canadian eligibility, fees and payout for each exact bounty.

lanes.label: Remote employment and contract listings
lanes.next_step: Verify that the specific role accepts Ontario/Canada applicants and review employment status, compensation, employer identity and application requirements.

sources.name: Upwork
sources.notes: A free Basic plan is listed, but bidding costs, Connects, service fees and payout eligibility must be checked before each use. No proposal or account action is automated.

sources.name: Contra
sources.notes: Free profile is advertised; terms also allow platform and payout fees. Verify the exact transaction fee, payment route, client contract and payout availability.

sources.name: Outlier
sources.notes: Official location guidelines list Canada, but projects can impose narrower restrictions. Requires identity/location checks; work supply, qualification and payout remain project-specific.

sources.name: Alignerr
sources.notes: Official onboarding describes applications, resume upload, identity verification and billing setup. A Canada testimonial is not proof that every Canadian applicant or project is eligible.

sources.name: Gumroad
sources.notes: Current pricing page lists 10% plus $0.50 for direct/profile sales and 30% for Discover marketplace sales; processing and country-specific payout details need checking. No sales are assumed.

sources.name: Government of Canada Business Benefits Finder
sources.notes: Use to discover programs, then read each program's official eligibility, legal applicant, deadlines, matching-fund and reporting rules. Funding is not guaranteed.

sources.name: NRC Industrial Research Assistance Program
sources.notes: Official minimum criteria include a Canadian incorporated for-profit business with up to 500 FTE developing and commercializing innovative technology. This is not an individual quick-income source and eligibility is not guaranteed.

sources.name: HackerOne
sources.notes: Read each program's scope and disclosure rules first. Identity information may be required to receive a bounty. No testing or submissions are automated.

sources.name: Bugcrowd
sources.notes: Public researcher signup is described, while private programs may require identity verification or other qualifications. Strictly limited to explicit program authorization and scope.

sources.name: GitHub public issue discovery
sources.notes: Existing connector discovers public issues; it does not prove a reward exists or that a contributor will be paid.

sources.name: Jobicy, Remote OK and Himalayas
sources.notes: Existing public feeds are normalized into intake; role freshness, employer legitimacy, location and compensation need human review.

sources.name: Employer Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby boards
sources.notes: Public employer-board connectors exist; 16 candidate employers remain a review-only shortlist and are not active until separately approved.

sources.name: YPAI Canadian freelance contributor openings
sources.canada_status: Canada-specific openings are advertised; each role, assessment and contributor eligibility must be checked
sources.cost_status: No contributor fee stated on reviewed opening pages; verify current contract and payout details before work
sources.notes: Reviewed openings advertised CAD hourly ranges for model evaluation, annotation and data collection, with PayPal, Wise or bank transfer described. Rates are advertisements, not guaranteed work or earnings; selection, task availability, approved hours and payout terms require direct verification. User must personally qualify and perform assigned work.

sources.name: CrowdGen by Appen
sources.canada_status: Project allocation and country eligibility vary; verify Ontario availability and mobile verification requirements
sources.cost_status: No upfront fee assumed; payout options and timing vary by country/project; verify current method and minimum
sources.notes: AI data collection, annotation and evaluation candidate. Official help describes monthly payment processing, generally by the 14th of the following month, with payout methods varying by location. Project allocation, qualifications, mobile verification and Canadian payout access remain to be checked.

sources.name: gend.me Web Developer
sources.canada_status: Ontario-based platform; confirm applicant eligibility and customer demand
sources.cost_status: Advertised CAD per approved developer credit plus AI tokens; tokens are not cash; verify wallet cash-out, approval and customer acceptance before counting any value
sources.notes: Candidate for web development work. Advertises CAD 15 per approved developer credit and AI Builder Tokens; payment depends on customer approval. Wallet withdrawal terms and cash conversion are not yet verified. No credits or tokens are treated as cash or income.

sources.name: BOSS bounty marketplace
sources.canada_status: Official documentation lists Canada for individual bounty earners; verify the specific bounty and account payout eligibility
sources.cost_status: Advertised earning fee 5% plus USD 0.60 and possible currency conversion; confirm current terms before accepting work
sources.notes: BOSS-marked public GitHub issues are discovery signals only. A marker, badge or bot summary is not proof of live funding, active sponsor authorization or payment. Verify the exact issue, sponsor, claim state, acceptance criteria, fees and withdrawal route. No claims or submissions are automated.

sources.name: Algora open-source bounties
sources.canada_status: Canadian access and payout eligibility not conclusively verified; check the exact bounty and account terms
sources.cost_status: Funding, fees and payout route require source-level verification before work
sources.notes: Potential open-source bounty discovery source. Current bounty availability, sponsor funding, Canadian eligibility and payout arrangements have not been independently confirmed. Treat as verify-first; no account connection or issue claim.

sources.name: GitHub Sponsors
sources.canada_status: Canada is listed as a supported receiving region; qualification and payout onboarding requirements apply
sources.cost_status: No upfront fee assumed; verify current payout, tax and banking terms and eligibility requirements
sources.notes: Longer-term sponsorship route. Receiving requires a qualifying contribution/profile history and account, banking, tax and two-factor setup. Sponsorships are not guaranteed and are not immediate task income.
